title: Cloudflare Workers Deploy/Debug Plan
description: A structured deploy plan for a Cloudflare Worker or Pages project, so cloudflare-workers-debugging's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/workers_debugging_audit.mjs.

deployTarget.description: Whether this deploys a Worker script or a Pages project.

authMethod.description: How wrangler authenticates: OAuth login (humans), scoped API token (CI), or the legacy global key (never).

ciDeploy.description: True if the deploy runs from CI rather than a human shell.

secretUploadMethod.description: How secrets reach wrangler secret put. cat-pipe is the alias trap that stores empty strings.

secretsVerifiedPostUpload.description: True if every secret is length-verified after upload (temporary endpoint or smoke test).

usesD1.description: True if the worker binds a D1 database.

d1MigrationsRemote.description: True if D1 migrations run with --remote against the real database, not the local .wrangler state.

oauthScopesRefreshedForNewProducts.description: True if wrangler logout/login re-consented scopes after adding D1/R2/Queues to the project.

observabilityEnabled.description: True if [observability] enabled = true is set in wrangler.toml for every environment.

compatibilityDateAgeDays.description: Age of compatibility_date in days. Quality gate: bumped within 90 days.

customDomain.description: True if the worker is reached via a custom_domain route.

workerRenamed.description: True if the worker script was renamed since the custom domain was assigned.

staleDomainAssignmentCleared.description: True if the old worker's domain assignment was deleted in the dashboard so the new worker re-creates it.

bindingsEnumeratedAtStartup.description: True if the worker logs its env binding keys at startup so missing bindings are loud, not silent.

cookieSetOnRedirect.description: True if a login flow sets a session cookie on the same response as a 302 redirect.

sessionCookieSameSite.description: SameSite attribute of the session cookie. Strict drops the cookie on the redirect navigation.

pagesPreviewProjectIsolated.description: True if manual Pages preview deploys use a distinct project or branch from git-push production deploys.

cpuLimitMonitored.description: True if 1101/1102 error counts are tracked over time.
